diagnosis: Unknown fatigue could be caused by a wide range of conditions including metabolic disorders, infectious diseases, autoimmune disorders, neurological disorders, and psychological issues. Initial workup should focus on common causes.
correct_orders: Laboratory tests: CBC, comprehensive metabolic panel, ESR/CRP, HIV, Hepatitis panels, Lyme disease test, thyroid function tests
Imaging studies (if clinically indicated): Chest X-ray, MRI/CT if neurological symptoms present
should_avoid: Ordering extensive and unnecessary testing at this stage may lead to increased cost and potential harm to the patient without providing additional diagnostic value.

rationale.Oxygen: To provide oxygen to the patient, essential for maintaining life
rationale.IV access \u00d72: To ensure adequate intravenous access for administration of fluids and medications
rationale.glucose check: To assess blood glucose level, which can be a cause of fatigue

physical_exam: Fatigue — exam tailored to chief complaint on arrival.
Soft, non-distended, no focal peritoneal signs on initial exam.
Alert and oriented unless perfusion or metabolic derangement present.
No acute rash; capillary refill and perfusion assessed.
